diagnostic.reportBugOpened: Bundle downloaded — drag the .json file into the report in the new tab
diagnostic.reportBugHint: Opens GitHub with a pre-filled issue and downloads the diagnostic bundle to attach (it's usually too large to paste)
diagnostic.title: Diagnostic export for a GitHub issue
diagnostic.description: Builds a diagnostic bundle you can attach to a GitHub issue. It is made only from fixed, structured fields:
diagnostic.copied: Bundle copied – paste it into the GitHub issue

includes.versions: App and build version, Node version, operating system and architecture
includes.settings: Instance settings as switches, numbers and fixed choices – and only whether an integration is set up, never its address or key
includes.counts: Counts: accounts per enabled domain, entries per table, database migration status
includes.events: Log events of the last 24 hours (errors: 7 days) as time, level, category, event key, error code and class, and code location (file name:line)

diagnostic.excludes: Not included: log text, names, usernames, email addresses, booking codes, flights and places, URLs with query strings, IP addresses, host name, directory paths, and any value from a request.
diagnostic.previewLabel: Preview – exactly this file is downloaded:
diagnostic.failedSection: Section “{{section}}” could not be collected (code {{code}}) and is marked as failed in the bundle.
diagnostic.exportFailed: The diagnostic bundle could not be created: {{reason}}. “Report bug” still opens the GitHub issue – without an attachment.
diagnostic.exportFailedToast: Issue opened without a diagnostic bundle – the export failed.

reasons.rateLimited: too many exports in a short time, please try again later
reasons.forbidden: only administrators may create a diagnostic bundle
reasons.rejected: the bundle failed its own checklist and was withheld

errorBoundary.title: Oops! Something went wrong
errorBoundary.message: The application encountered an unexpected error. Please try refreshing the page.

saveErrors.validation: Some details are not valid. Please check the fields and try again.
saveErrors.duplicate: An entry with these details already exists.
saveErrors.dbUnavailable: The database cannot be reached right now. Please try again shortly.
saveErrors.rateLimited: Too many requests in a short time. Please wait a moment.
saveErrors.demo: This cannot be saved in the demo account.
saveErrors.network: The server cannot be reached. Please check the connection.
saveErrors.timezoneUnavailable: The server cannot determine the place's time zone right now. The time was not saved, so it is not stored wrongly as UTC — please tell your administrator.
saveErrors.timezoneUnresolved: No time zone is known for this place, because it has no coordinates or catalogue entry. The time was not saved, so it is not stored wrongly as UTC — please complete the place or choose another one.
saveErrors.localTimeNonexistent: This time does not exist on that day at this place (clock change). Please choose a time before or after it.
saveErrors.zoneUnknown: The server does not know this time zone. Please pick the place again or tell your administrator.
saveErrors.staleBundle: This page is older than the server and sent the time in the old format. Nothing was saved — please reload the page and save again.

time.yourTimeTitle: The same moment in your time zone ({{zone}}). The local time at the place is always shown.
time.utcFallbackTitle: No time zone is known for this place — the time is UTC, not local time.

domain.flight_desc: Import bookings, routes on the map, airline/airport achievements.
domain.cruise_desc: Ships, ports, sea days, cruise-line achievements.
domain.roadtrip_desc: Multi-day journeys by motorhome, car or bike: stations, nights, the road between.
domain.rail_desc: Train journeys like flights: stations, train number, class, seat, kilometres. (Beta)
domain.rental_desc: Rental cars with station, period, car and the kilometres from the invoice. (Beta)

modules.title: Modules
modules.desc: Enabled modules show up in navigation, dashboards, map, achievements and stats. Disabled modules are hidden — your data is preserved.

sub.rail: Beta: a logbook for train journeys
sub.rental: Beta: a logbook for rental cars

domains.title: What do you want to track?
domains.desc: You can enable or disable modules anytime in Settings.

domainTabs.driftFallback: The "{{tab}}" tab was disabled — back to General.

update.headline: Version {{version}} available
update.viewFullNotes: View full release notes on GitHub

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.message: This page doesn't exist or has moved.

adminOnly.title: Administrators only
adminOnly.body: This area is reserved for whoever administers this instance. Your account does not have the rights for it — ask an administrator if you need them.

table.scrollHint: The table is wider than the view — scroll sideways for more columns.
table.hiddenColumns: Columns hidden for lack of width: {{count}}. A wider window shows them all; “Columns” changes the selection.

emojiPicker.unavailable: The emoji picker cannot load here. You can still paste an emoji into the field.

demoBetaNotice.title: Beta features are switched on
demoBetaNotice.body: This demo runs with the beta features switched on. What you see here may still change – your feedback is welcome.

setupIncompleteBanner.message: This instance has not been set up yet.

clockChange.gap: This time does not exist on that day at this place (clock change). Please choose a time before or after it.
clockChange.repeated: This time occurs twice on that day at this place (clock change). The earlier one is saved.

list.loadFailedHint: Your data is not affected — it is still there. Try again in a moment.

discard.title: Discard changes?
discard.message: What you entered in this form will be lost.

form.savedButRefreshFailed: Saved. The list could not be refreshed.
